label: Beverage can
test_scope: Offline synthetic tests. Forces and mass are engineering assumptions, not hardware measurements.
physics_source: Generated from model.json and convex collision pieces
physics_notes:
# beverage_can

Evidence: f5360, f6963. See `spec.json` for source crop boxes and raw point/edge observations; `../measurements.json` retains metric point and rectangle measurements.

Geometry is a parametric fit to visible contours. Nominal local dimensions: [0.066, 0.066, 0.168] m; evaluated bounds: [0.066, 0.066, 0.168] m. Curved-object sizes use inventory/product-scale priors checked against depth; crop boundaries often include occlusion and must not be treated as metric silhouettes. Hidden backs, wall thicknesses, pivots, closure threads, and mass are assumptions.

Each instance stores its own observed frame and estimated bottom centre. Raw depth lies on the visible surface; registration offsets it toward the hidden centre using an assumed half-depth and subtracts half the height. Yaw is inferred from shelf/door alignment, not fitted from full object tracking. This is offline registration, not online pose estimation. Reported approximately 4% depth uncertainty is compounded by crop, occlusion and centroid error (roughly 4–7 cm or more). Do not combine moving-door observations at different times without a parent transform.

Visual parts: body, tab. 17 convex collision pieces retain the main container opening where applicable. Thin-wall hull sectors and rectangular grids approximate curved inner corners. Soft items provide tentative constitutive parameters under physics.deformable and a rigid contact fallback; no soft-body or fluid rollout has been validated. Closed containers require their separate closure collider attached. Screw caps have coupled rotational/axial controls; press-fit lids and stoppers use removal guides and become free bodies on release. Joint ranges are assumed, not observed limits.

Photo textures preserve visible print and lighting. They are not calibrated intrinsic albedo; roughness/metallic/transmission are material priors. Unknown rear label regions use a flat sampled colour. Use `material_variants` to substitute photo/closure materials and scale repeated instances. glTF contains the representative material; variant source maps and Blender datablocks are supplied. Generated can-front restoration and pulp texture are declared in ../review/texture_generation.md; other incomplete print remains photographed evidence.

Mass 0.491 kg and the material-specific physics parameters are unmeasured priors; see physics for justification, ranges and deformability. Mesh triangle count 12376; collision pieces 17. Model has no hidden support plane in exports. `render_0.png` and `render_1.png` are offline studio views, not calibrated camera reprojections.

physics_properties.mass_basis: Representative tall 473 mL-class filled can: approximately 0.473 kg liquid + 0.018 kg shell. Volume class inferred from shape; short cans use per-instance mass.
physics_properties.density_definition: shell/material density prior, not density of filled outer bounding volume
physics_properties.center_of_mass_basis: symmetric contents-weighted estimate in bottom-centred local asset frame
